chapters.title: Birth and Family
chapters.text:
[DRAFT — human-written placeholder]

The flat had two rooms and a balcony that his mother used as a kitchen. He was the middle child of three, born in the winter of 1970 to a father who checked meters for the electricity board.

What the family could afford — and what it could not — would shape most of what followed.
